m.s: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large deep frying pan over high heat. Add {beef_mince} and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until well browned. Don't stir too often, as the brown bits are the flavour.
Turn the heat down to medium. Add diced {onion}, {capsicum} and {zucchini} and cook for 8 minutes until soft. Add crushed {garlic}, {oregano} and {tompaste} and stir for 2 minutes.
Add {tintom} and half a tin of water. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then season well with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 200°C.
Meanwhile cook {pasta} in a big pot of salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, as it finishes in the oven. Drain.
Mix the pasta through the sauce and tip into a large baking dish. Scatter over {cheese} and {mozz}. Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving so it holds together when you scoop it out.

l: Cut into squares once it cools. Reheats like a dream. Keeps 3 days in the fridge, and it freezes well.
g: Make the GF portion in its own smaller dish with GF pasta.
